title: File:Taipan Wall (26068994254).jpg
claims: The photograph shows the orange-red sandstone wall of Taipan Wall in late-afternoon light, with horizontal ledges, dark vertical streaks, sparse trees at its base and a clear blue sky above; the file page gives the camera location as 36.895448 S, 142.378396 E.

Commons titles the photograph Taipan Wall (26068994254).jpg and describes it as Taipan Wall; it is a rock-wall view, not the GPT100 Miler start line, a course marking, an aid station, a timing mat, a runner or a race-day crowd.
The author is Ed Dunens; the file is licensed CC BY 2.0; the photograph was taken on 2016-04-22 at 17:31; the original is 5,757 x 3,838 pixels and 22,838,490 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 293,590 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Ed Dunens, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
